selection_reasoning: These two tasks form a coherent multi-hop dependency chain. The player must first mine carrots from a carrot crop, then use those carrots to trade with a Leatherworker villager for Leather Pants. In Minecraft, Leatherworker villagers can trade various items, and carrots serve as a common tradeable resource. The dependency is natural: you need an item (carrots) to use as trade currency with the villager. This sequence requires observable actions (breaking crop blocks, interacting with a villager) and is verifiable through inventory checks.

edges.reason: Carrots must be harvested first to have emeralds/trade currency to exchange with a Leatherworker villager for Leather Pants

milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining fully-grown carrot crops (age=7) drops carrot items into the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 carrots, so any carrot in inventory confirms successful mining. The item ID is 'carrot' (singular) — the dropped item from the 'carrots' block.

Uses inventory_has because trading with the Leatherworker villager (4 emeralds → 1 leather_leggings) places the item directly into the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 leather_leggings, so any presence confirms a successful trade. The correct Minecraft item ID is 'leather_leggings' (not 'leather_pants').

scene_description: A flat grassy area with a carrot farm in front of the player spawn and a Leatherworker villager in a fenced pen behind the spawn. The player starts with 16 emeralds. They must first mine fully-grown carrots from the farm (Task 1), then find and trade with the Leatherworker villager for Leather Pants using their emeralds (Task 2). The carrot farm is a 9x6 patch of farmland with fully-grown carrots (age=7) and a central water source. The villager pen is a 5x5 cobblestone-floored enclosure with oak fences and an open south-facing gate.
task_text: First, mine carrots from the carrot farm ahead of you. Then, find the Leatherworker villager in the fenced pen nearby and trade your emeralds for Leather Pants.
design_notes: Layout: Player spawns at center of a flat grass platform (21x29 blocks). Carrot farm (9x6 fully-grown carrots on farmland with central water) is ~2-7 blocks ahead (positive Z direction). Leatherworker villager pen (5x5 cobblestone + oak fence enclosure with open south gate) is ~4-8 blocks behind and to the right (positive X, negative Z direction). Player has 16 emeralds (trade costs 4 per leather_leggings). Villager has NoAI=1b so it stays stationary. Fence gate is open for easy access. The area is fully cleared of natural terrain to ensure a clean, controlled scene.
